status: Report definitions only. These are NOT production trust rules and do not supersede any invariant in CLAUDE.md.
source_coverage: ChEMBL 37 bulk release only. Absence of evidence here is absence in ChEMBL 37, not absence in the literature and not absence across the project's six production sources.

claim_granularity.note: Evidence is assigned per molecule-target claim. A well-evidenced target does not upgrade any other claim for the same molecule, and a binding claim never upgrades a functional claim at the same target. Curated action_type is retained on curated claims; endpoint types are retained on experimental claims and are never pooled across types.

included_exact.reason: Reuses CLAUDE.md invariant 1 (a value is a measurement only if the source says it is) and the pipeline's unit normalisation. A non-'=' relation is a censored bound, not a measured value.

retained_as_bound.reason: Censored observations are kept as bounds and counted, but never enter a numeric summary or a threshold pass.

measurement_validity.flags_do_not_exclude: ChEMBL's own data-validity flags are recorded per measurement and reported, not used to drop rows - matching how the production pipeline stores them on `measurements`.

documented_exclusions.reason: Reused verbatim from the production pipeline's documented known-bad upstream records (see docs/DATA-QUALITY-LOG.md). Excluded on this path too, with the reason preserved, never silently dropped.
documented_exclusions.organism_based_format: Within assay_type=F, bao_format label 'organism-based format' is excluded: whole-organism readouts whose ChEMBL target is a species, not a molecular target.

endpoint_classes.rule: endpoint_class = <role>:<standard_type>, where role is 'binding' for assay_type B and 'functional' for assay_type F.
endpoint_classes.never_pooled: Ki, Kd, binding IC50, functional IC50, EC50, AC50 and Kb are separate classes. Replication is counted inside one class only. Two binding measurements never establish an action, and a functional endpoint is never merged with a binding endpoint.
endpoint_classes.pooling: log10-space median within one (claim, endpoint_class), matching CLAUDE.md invariant 3.

provenance_class.publication: docs.doc_type = 'PUBLICATION' and a pubmed_id or doi is present.
provenance_class.deposited_dataset: docs.doc_type = 'DATASET' - one bulk deposit (e.g. Sanger GDSC, DrugMatrix), regardless of how many activity rows it carries.
provenance_class.unresolved: No doc row, or a doc with no pubmed_id, doi or patent_id.

study_identity.counts_original_evidence_not_appearances: Support is counted in distinct studies, never in activity rows. Several assays from one paper are one study; identical values re-deposited under one dataset are one study.
study_identity.duplicate_resolution: Two doc rows collapse to one study when they share a pubmed_id, or share a doi. ChEMBL's own potential_duplicate flag is retained on the measurement and reported.

curated_support.definition: A ChEMBL drug_mechanism record for this molecule family at this target, carrying at least one traceable mechanism reference (mechanism_refs) or a mechanism_comment.
curated_support.specificity: Qualifies only at the target/action specificity ChEMBL asserts. A PROTEIN FAMILY or PROTEIN COMPLEX mechanism is Supported at that level and is never expanded into supported claims for individual members.
curated_support.caveat: Curated support is one curator's assertion. It does not imply an independently replicated measurement.

multiple_study_support.definition: Two or more distinct studies with provenance_class 'publication' carrying qualifying exact measurements for the same claim within one endpoint_class.
multiple_study_support.caveat: Multiple papers are a documented proxy for independence, not proof of independent laboratories, independent experiments, or independent material. Deposited datasets, patents and unresolved documents are retained and reported but never create multi-study support.

supported.recorded_separately: curated_support and multiple_study_support are stored as separate flags so the report can show each route and their intersection.

preliminary.definition: At least one identifiable study (publication, patent or deposited dataset) with a qualifying exact measurement for the claim, and no Supported-tier evidence for that claim.

limited_or_unresolved.definition: Evidence exists but is insufficient for the claim being evaluated. The specific reason is preserved, never discarded.

reasons.curated_untraceable: A curated mechanism with no reference and no comment.
reasons.curated_no_target_assigned: A curated mechanism whose drug_mechanism.tid is null.
reasons.curated_indirect: drug_mechanism.direct_interaction = 0 - an indirect mechanism, not a measured target relationship.
reasons.censored_only: Every measurement for the claim is a censored bound.
reasons.invalid_units_only: Every measurement carries units the report cannot normalise.
reasons.unresolved_study_provenance: Support exists but no measurement resolves to an identifiable study.
reasons.ambiguous_target_assignment: Target assignment is homologous, multiple, unchecked or non-molecular.
reasons.documented_exclusion: Every backing record is on the pipeline's documented known-bad exclusion list.

tiers.no_eligible_evidence: The molecule is in the catalogue and ChEMBL 37 holds no curated mechanism and no assessable activity for it at any target. A coverage gap, retained in the catalogue.
tiers.not_assessed: The source needed for this molecule/source combination was unavailable. Recorded as unknown, never as a negative finding.

target_specificity.human_direct_single_protein: target_type='SINGLE PROTEIN' and tax_id=9606 and confidence_score=9 and relationship_type='D' and variant_id is null. This is the main empirical comparison.
target_specificity.human_direct_single_protein_mutant: As above but variant_id is not null.
target_specificity.human_direct_complex: target_type in ('PROTEIN COMPLEX','PROTEIN COMPLEX GROUP') and tax_id=9606 and confidence_score=7.
target_specificity.nonhuman: target tax_id is present and not 9606.
target_specificity.confidence_note: ChEMBL confidence scores 9, 7 and 8 are different target-assignment categories (direct single protein, direct complex subunits, homologous single protein). They are not a quality ranking, and a generic '>= 7' filter mixes them. This report never uses '>= 7' as a proxy for direct human single-protein evidence.

conflicts.action_conflict: Two or more curated mechanism records for the same (molecule family, target) whose action_type maps to opposing parent_type (POSITIVE MODULATOR vs NEGATIVE MODULATOR).
conflicts.measurement_dispersion: Within one (claim, endpoint_class) with qualifying exact values from two or more distinct studies, log10(max/min) > 2 - values disagreeing by more than a hundredfold.
conflicts.effect_on_tier: A conflict never raises a tier. Contradictory reports are shown, and a claim with a conflict keeps its tier and carries the conflict flag and detail, so accumulating incompatible reports cannot look like stronger support.

thresholds.primary_rule: A (claim, endpoint_class) passes threshold T when the log10-space median of its qualifying exact nM values is <= T.
thresholds.sensitivity_rule: Also reported: passes when ANY qualifying exact value is <= T.
thresholds.scope: Applied only inside the fixed cohort-1 candidate set. Thresholds never admit a molecule, never remove one, and say nothing about physiological exposure. Curated weak relationships (e.g. caffeine's curated ADORA3 mechanism at Ki = 100 uM) keep their catalogue membership and their curated tier at every threshold.
